mission: Build and operate Life OS and Persona, prioritizing a high-quality Persona Content Conveyor.
businessOutcome: Produce real, distinctive Instagram content through a repeatable evidence-based growth and learning loop.
principles: zero recurring AI cost by default
hardSafety: never write or merge to main
never mutate or deploy production without authorization
never modify frozen or recovery accepted branches
never live publish without explicit authorization
never destructively reset or clean unrelated work
never purchase services or invoke paid APIs
never trigger GitHub Actions while unavailable or exhausted

qualityPolicy.rule: Every meaningful stage requires executed evidence and stage-specific QC; weak or generic output may not silently advance.
qualityPolicy.antiGenericQuestion: Could essentially the same material be given to hundreds of other creators?

backlog.title: Define executable Persona content conveyor state machine

payload.goal: Create one canonical, durable, quality-gated conveyor contract across real context through editorial ready.
acceptance: canonical stages and transitions are executable
durable evidence and next action are represented
tests prove weak output cannot advance
payload.next_action: inspect existing Persona contracts and implement the smallest compatible state-machine slice
payload.prompt: Implement the smallest coherent Persona Content Conveyor state-machine slice. Reuse canonical contracts and durable state, preserve existing behavior, add deterministic tests, and do not publish or deploy.

payload.goal: Run deterministic supervisor regression without Codex.
payload.command: cd tools/autonomous_supervisor && python3 -m unittest tests.test_supervisor && python3 -m py_compile supervisor.py

backlog.title: Connect Archetype and Brand evidence to the conveyor

payload.goal: Make brand identity and signature evidence available to content decisions without duplicating state.
payload.next_action: map existing Archetype/Brand data into the conveyor contract
payload.prompt: Connect existing Archetype and Brand evidence to the canonical conveyor with truthful missing-data states and deterministic anti-generic tests. Do not invent user facts.

payload.goal: Generate bounded content opportunities from real context and brand evidence.
payload.next_action: implement deterministic idea evidence and QC slice
payload.prompt: Implement the smallest evidence-bound Persona idea and QC slice using existing context/cache. Preserve FREE_ONLY and reject unverified actionable ideas.

payload.goal: Connect immutable MediaAsset provenance and shooting sessions to the conveyor.
acceptance: source provenance and QC are durable
payload.prompt: Connect existing immutable MediaAsset and shooting-session contracts to the conveyor. Add provenance/QC tests without modifying frozen media engines.

backlog.title: Complete the real video lane through editorial ready

payload.goal: Drive a real video from approved idea and media through safe edit QA to editorial ready.
payload.next_action: integrate proven video contracts as one bounded lane
payload.prompt: Implement the next bounded video-lane gap using existing Video Engine and Media Router contracts. Preserve frozen engines, require objective crop/quality QA, and stop at EDITORIAL_READY.

payload.goal: Create a mobile-readable carousel production lane with narrative and design QC.
acceptance: slide ordering and hierarchy are canonical
mobile readability and anti-generic QA pass
payload.next_action: implement one deterministic carousel vertical slice
payload.prompt: Implement the smallest first-class carousel lane with narrative, slide, typography, mobile-readability and anti-generic QC. Do not route it through the video renderer.

backlog.title: Build the first-class photo editorial lane

payload.goal: Create restrained photo selection, processing and editorial packaging.
acceptance: source detail and composition are protected
editorial angle and caption are linked
payload.next_action: implement one deterministic photo vertical slice
payload.prompt: Implement the smallest photo/editorial lane using immutable source media, restrained processing, composition QA, caption linkage and deterministic export validation.

backlog.title: Unify stage and final quality court decisions

payload.goal: Require independent evidence-backed quality decisions before editorial ready.
acceptance: all three lanes use the same decision vocabulary
payload.next_action: consolidate proven gates without rewriting lanes
payload.prompt: Unify existing deterministic and critic quality evidence across video, carousel and photo. Require executable evidence and bounded repair before EDITORIAL_READY.

backlog.title: Complete safe publisher contracts and authorization gate

payload.goal: Prepare exact immutable assets for provider submission without live publishing.
payload.prompt: Implement or strengthen safe Publisher contracts and local simulations. Require explicit LIVE authorization and authoritative provider confirmation. Never publish or touch production.

backlog.title: Close the authoritative metrics and learning loop

payload.goal: Turn real provider metrics into bounded observations, hypotheses and next experiments.
acceptance: learning changes the next bounded experiment
payload.prompt: Implement the smallest provider-neutral metrics and learning loop using authoritative evidence only. Never fabricate publication or performance data.

backlog.title: Audit and close the next bounded sync integrity gap

payload.goal: Improve canonical sync where it supports truthful Persona state.
acceptance: one concrete integrity gap is fixed
payload.prompt: Inspect current sync contracts and fix exactly one smallest repository-evidenced integrity gap that supports Persona or canonical state. Add tests; avoid broad refactors.

backlog.title: Audit and close the next bounded privacy boundary gap

payload.goal: Preserve least-privilege access and secret-safe evidence across Persona flows.
acceptance: one concrete boundary is verified or fixed
payload.next_action: inspect existing trust boundaries and choose one bounded gap
payload.prompt: Inspect current Persona trust boundaries and fix exactly one smallest privacy/security gap. Do not expose or rotate secrets and do not touch production.

backlog.title: Integrate verified candidates into one canonical proposal

payload.goal: Prepare a conflict-aware integration proposal from verified candidates.
payload.prompt: Create a conflict-aware isolated integration candidate from the verified dependency SHAs. Run local regression and critic. Do not merge to main, push, deploy, or modify production.

payload.goal: Select and complete the next smallest mission-aligned verified gap.
acceptance: gap is evidenced by repository and durable state
payload.next_action: inspect mission, queue, READY candidates, failures and repository state
payload.prompt: Read mission.v1.json and the durable supervisor queue/events. Inspect actual repository state and READY candidates. Select exactly one smallest highest-value gap serving the Persona Content Conveyor, or a Life OS truth/privacy/sync blocker. Implement it in the isolated worktree with deterministic tests and critic. Do not touch main, production, frozen branches, paid APIs, or GitHub Actions.
